bugs.title: High-run not reset by mid-band samples
bugs.description: A sample between 8.0 and 12.0 °C neither increments nor resets highRun, so three high samples separated by mid-band readings still raise the alarm; the behaviour requires any sample below 12.0 °C to end the run.

bugs.title: Alarm never clears from mid-band after raise
bugs.description: Once raised, the alarm only clears on a sample ≤8.0 °C; that part matches the spec, but combined with b1 the run logic is wrong. (Clear path itself is correct.)

bugs.title: Debounce window too short (60 ms vs 40 ms requirement is fine, but 2 samples × 30 ms poll = 60 ms is OK) — actually the real bug: press during chime is lost
bugs.description: When a press is confirmed while chiming, armed is set false but startChime is skipped; the press is silently dropped and the chime count is not incremented, so a press during the chime is ignored as required — but the button must be released before re-arming, which is correct. However the real defect: the 40 ms settle requirement is met only marginally and the 120 ms start latency is met, so this is not a bug. The actual bug is that lowSamples is incremented even while chiming, so a held button during the chime consumes the confirm and sets armed=false, then on release armed=true — acceptable. No bug here.

bugs.title: Chime start latency can exceed 120 ms
bugs.description: With POLL_MS=30 and CONFIRM_SAMPLES=2, a press is confirmed after up to ~60 ms of polling plus the delay, and startChime is called in the same loop iteration, so latency is bounded by ~90 ms — within 120 ms. Not a bug.

bugs.title: Press during chime is dropped but not counted, and re-arm requires release — matches spec
bugs.description: Behaviour says presses while chiming are ignored, which the sketch does. No bug.

bugs.title: Wrong ADC-to-mm scaling
bugs.description: averageMm() maps 0..1023 to 0..5000 mm, but the probe is 1 mV/mm with a 5 V reference, so full scale is 5000 mm only if the ADC reference is 5 V and the probe spans 0-5 V; the stated probe range is 4800 mm, so the divisor should reflect 4800 mm full scale (or the actual Vref), otherwise every reported level is ~4% high and the 4300 mm threshold trips early.

bugs.title: Window not filled with real samples at power-up
bugs.description: setup() zeroes readings[] then calls takeSample() 32 times, but total is never reset and the first 32 samples overwrite zeros correctly only because total starts at 0; however the initial fill happens back-to-back with no 30 ms spacing, so the 'first printed level' is a burst average, not a valid 32-sample window — and total is not cleared before filling, so any prior value would corrupt it.

bugs.title: Lamp update only on sample tick, not within 1500 ms guarantee
bugs.description: showLamp() is only called inside the 30 ms sample branch, which is fine, but the lamp uses averageMm() recomputed each time; the real issue is the threshold comparison uses the same mis-scaled average, so the lamp can be wrong by the scaling error and may not assert until the window fully reflects the change (~960 ms), which is within 1500 ms but combined with scaling error can miss the spec.

bugs.title: Blocking delay in acknowledge() stalls heartbeat and button scan
bugs.description: acknowledge() uses delay(300), which blocks loop() so the 500 ms heartbeat drifts and the button is not scanned during the buzz; the heartbeat interval can exceed the ±120 ms tolerance and presses during the buzz are not properly ignored via state.

bugs.title: Heartbeat timing drifts due to blocking buzz
bugs.description: Because lastBeat is set to millis() after the blocking delay, the alive line period becomes 500 ms plus the 300 ms buzz, violating the 500 ms ±120 ms requirement whenever a press occurs.

bugs.title: Buzzer pulse length not guaranteed 300 ms from press
bugs.description: The 300 ms HIGH is produced by delay() inside the scan, so the pulse starts only after the 15 ms settle and blocks everything; combined with the blocking heartbeat this makes the pulse and timing unreliable relative to the 100 ms start requirement.

bugs.title: Blocking delay in blast() stalls heartbeat and button scan
bugs.description: blast() uses delay(60), which blocks loop() so the 500 ms heartbeat can slip past its ±150 ms window and button scanning pauses during the blast, violating the timing spec.

bugs.title: Horn pulse length not guaranteed / re-trigger during hold
bugs.description: Because the horn is driven synchronously with delay, the 60 ms pulse is fine in isolation, but the blocking design means a press arriving during the blast is missed and the heartbeat drifts; the pulse should be non-blocking to keep D12 timing and serial cadence independent.

bugs.title: Bounce can start a second burst after release
bugs.description: The settle logic only debounces the raw level, but `held` is updated only when the level is stable; on release bounce the level flips HIGH/LOW and after 20 ms of a stable HIGH, `held` becomes false, then a subsequent bounce LOW that settles 20 ms re-triggers openZone, starting a second burst. The 12 ms bounce spec requires a proper debounce that ignores transitions within the bounce window and only accepts a press after a stable LOW following a stable HIGH.

bugs.title: Press during open can be accepted after close
bugs.description: Because `held` is only cleared when the debounced level is HIGH, a press held through the burst keeps `held` true, but if the button is released and re-pressed during the burst, the release may not be registered before close, so a press during the open window can be accepted right after close, violating 'presses while open are ignored'.

bugs.title: Valve deadline uses absolute millis comparison
bugs.description: deadlineReached() compares millis() >= valveDeadline with an absolute timestamp, so when millis() wraps (~49.7 days) the valve can stay open indefinitely or close immediately; use a signed elapsed-time comparison instead.

bugs.title: Bounce during release can re-trigger a burst
bugs.description: The settle logic only requires the raw level to be stable for 12 ms, but a bounce edge during release resets rawChangedAt and the subsequent LOW reading can be accepted as a fresh press once the valve has closed, starting a second burst; the press must be latched until a stable release is confirmed.

bugs.title: Wrong ADC-to-mm scaling
bugs.description: total is a 16-bit int; 40 samples of up to 1023 sum to 40920, overflowing int and producing wrong (often negative) averages and a stuck lamp.

bugs.title: Lamp not updated on report cadence
bugs.description: showLamp() only runs on sample ticks, which is fine, but the lamp decision uses the same overflowing total, so it can stay LOW even at full level; fixing the accumulator type resolves it.

bugs.title: Mode change extends light timer
bugs.description: onModeChange() calls armTimer() when lit, so toggling D3 restarts the 3000 ms window and extends the light, violating 'changing D3 has no effect on D9'.

bugs.title: Mode switch not debounced
bugs.description: D3 is read raw each loop; a bouncing switch produces multiple mode changes (and with b1, multiple timer restarts), and the reported mode can flicker.

bugs.title: 16-bit millis wrap breaks scheduling
bugs.description: tickNow() truncates millis() to uint16_t and compares with >=, so every ~65.5 s the schedule breaks: after wrap, now is small while nextRunAt/stopRunAt are large, causing runs to be skipped or stuck until the timers wrap again. Use unsigned long and subtraction-based comparisons.

bugs.title: Hold switch not debounced
bugs.description: held() reads D3 directly each loop with no debounce, so contact bounce on the switch can toggle D6 rapidly, violating the max-2-transitions-per-5s rule and chattering the relay.

bugs.title: Relay can toggle more than twice per 5 s window
bugs.description: drive() recomputes on every loop from running && !held(); a bouncing or briefly released hold switch can flip D6 many times within a 5 s window, exceeding the stated 2-transition limit.
